test_title: PYST 64: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Rajesh is sitting second to the right of Ramesh. Ramesh is sitting to the immediate left of Suresh. Nimesh is sitting second to the right of Jayesh. Paresh is sitting second to the right of Rajesh. Jayesh is the immediate neighbour of Rajesh and Paresh. Who is sitting between Ramesh and Paresh?
solution:
Given: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Rajesh is sitting second to the right of Ramesh.

2) Ramesh is sitting to the immediate left of Suresh.

3) Paresh is sitting second to the right of Rajesh.

4) Nimesh is sitting second to the right of Jayesh.

5) Jayesh is the immediate neighbour of Rajesh and Paresh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d12e70f9ae1b954b8f3f56225d6dbf8ae86a4b2e70da38685e58a2d35459f790.png] 

Here, Nimesh is sitting between Ramesh and Paresh.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
